## Weekly logbook entry (personal)

> The logbook is individual. Do not copy a teammate's entry.

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Name and student ID | |
| Week | |
| Planned work | |
| Work completed | |
| Evidence, such as commits or documents | |
| Problems and how they were resolved | |
| Hours spent | |
| Plan for next week | |

### Reflection

Two or three sentences on what you learned, not what you did. This is the part assessors read.

### AI use

If AI tools were used, name them and describe what they did and how you verified the result.
